definition: The system Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada uses to manage applications for three federal economic immigration programmes: the Federal Skilled Worker Program, the Canadian Experience Class and the Federal Skilled Trades Program.
longform: Meeting the minimum requirements of one of the three programmes gets a candidate into the pool. It does not by itself produce an invitation to apply for permanent residence — that depends on a separate ranking score.
